workItem.title: Handoff context survives every role hop

requirements.statement: Risks, open questions, blockers, assumptions and notes raised in one role's handoff must reach every later role's handoff for the same work item until explicitly resolved.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Given a BA to Architect handoff with a risk, open question, blocker and note, the Architect to Developer and Developer to Quality handoffs still contain them.
A handoff may list resolved items by exact text; resolved items are not carried forward and the resolution is recorded.
Items supplied on the later handoff are added without duplicating carried items.
Carry-forward only reads handoffs of the same work item that target the new handoff's source role.
Decision records, notes and revision metadata continue to be preserved on every handoff.
A regression drives the chain through real MCP praxis_workflow_preview and praxis_workflow_apply calls and checks the persisted state file.

openQuestions: Should resolved items remain visible in later handoffs as history?

decisions.statement: Add optional resolved: string[] to the handoff command and handoff record. createHandoff-time carry-forward in workflow.ts: take the latest handoff of this work item whose targetRole equals the new handoff's sourceRole; carry its risks, openQuestions, blockers, assumptions, minus any text listed in resolved; union with items on the new command, deduplicated, order preserved. Resolved items are stored in the handoff's resolved[] for audit. Items resolved are not removed from earlier handoffs (history is immutable). notes: command value, else incoming handoff notes, else state notes. Open question answered: resolved items stay visible only as resolved[] history, not as active items. Handoff fingerprint covers the carried content so replay detection stays correct. Existing persisted handoffs without resolved[] stay valid (field defaults to []).

Core tests: handoff-context.test.ts (7), negative control verified.

history.note: A risk, open question, blocker or note recorded in a BA to Architect handoff is absent from the Architect to Developer and Developer to Quality handoffs, because each handoff starts from workflow-level fields only. The installed Desktop bundle additionally hard-codes risks: [] and omits notes and decision records. Reproduced 2026-10-20 in current source with a three-hop chain.
